cmd=rm -f /root/b1/logs/b1_kv_capture.pcap /root/b1/logs/b1_kv_capture.pcap.pid
which tcpdump
setsid nohup tcpdump -i eth0 -nn -s 96 -U -w /root/b1/logs/b1_kv_capture.pcap -c 200000 'tcp and not port 22'     > /root/b1/logs/netcap_tcpdump.log 2>&1 </dev/null &
echo $! > /root/b1/logs/b1_kv_capture.pcap.

cmd=pid=$(cat /root/b1/logs/b1_kv_capture.pcap.pid 2>/dev/null)
if [[ -n "$pid" ]] && kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then kill -INT "$pid"; sleep 3; fi
kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null && { echo "还在 → SIGTERM"; kill -TERM "$pid" 2>/dev/null; sleep 2; }
echo "--- tcpdump 自己报的收包统计"
cat /root/

cmd=self=$$
pids=$(ps -eo pid,args --no-headers | grep '[h]f download' | awk '{print $1}' | grep -v "^$self$")
if [[ -z "$pids" ]]; then echo "  A: 没有模型下载进程（无需停）"; else
  for p in $pids; do echo "  A: SIGTERM pid=$p $(ps -o args= -p $p 2>/dev/null | head -c 60)"; kill -TERM "$p
